ValidationRule.description: Cannot Add, Edit or Delete Sales Billing Forecast record once Opportunity is Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR( ISPICKVAL( Forecast_Opportunity__r.StageName , '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(Forecast_Opportunity__r.StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(Forecast_Opportunity__r.StageName, '7 - Closed') ), $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN', NOT($Permission.Edit_SBF_Lines_in_Late_Stage_Opp) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit Sales Billing Forecast lines once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
